'''Rock salt''' was a substance that was available on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] that attended the wedding of [[Eyvind/Legends|Eyvind]] and [[Ariela]] brought rock [[Salt/Legends|salt]] as a gift.<ref name="Drawing the Maps of Peace: The Moisture Farmer's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Drawing the Maps of Peace: The Moisture Farmer's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
